h1: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN prepares detailed cost estimates for construction and finishing work, as well as for the materials required to renovate apartments, private homes, and other spaces in Bratislava and Vienna. An estimate lets you determine the expected renovation budget in advance, assess the scope of work, and plan expenses before the project begins.

The cost of preparing an estimate is €5/m² of the property’s floor area. The calculation takes into account the specific features of the space, its actual dimensions, the condition of the surfaces, and the planned renovation work.

Preparing the estimate includes measuring the actual dimensions of the walls, floors, and ceilings and identifying geometric deviations in the surfaces. The data obtained is used to calculate the volume of construction and finishing work and the required quantity of materials.
This approach helps account for the actual conditions of the property and reduces the likelihood of significant discrepancies between preliminary calculations and actual costs.
Cost calculation for construction and finishing work

The estimate lists the work included in the project, with quantities and costs. Depending on the condition of the property and the planned renovation, the calculation may include preparatory, construction, and finishing operations.
The detailed structure of the estimate helps the client understand what makes up the budget, compare contractor bids, and control spending at each stage of implementation.
A separate section of the estimate is dedicated to materials. For the planned work, the required quantities and costs of construction and finishing materials are calculated.

The specification helps plan purchases, estimate expenses, and agree on the budget before renovation work begins. If the selected materials or the scope of work change, the calculation may need to be adjusted.

The result of the service is a detailed renovation cost estimate that includes the calculated quantities and cost of the work, a list of the required materials, their quantities, and their approximate cost.
The document can be used for preliminary budgeting, approving renovation work, planning purchases, and subsequently monitoring expenses.
The price for preparing an estimate is €5/m² of the property’s floor area.
If you order a renovation from DUMSKAYA DESIGN, the cost of preparing the estimate is deducted from the cost of the renovation work.

The estimate is based on the available information about the property and the agreed scope of work. Final costs may change if hidden defects are discovered or if design decisions, the scope of work, or material prices change.

Preparing a detailed estimate is an important step in organizing an apartment or house renovation. It helps you assess the financial costs in advance and establish a consistent process for carrying out the project.
